decisions.reason: This service extends the firm's established crewing business, has already been kept once, and its strategic fit and prior commitment make management likely to persist with it.

The maritime education programme is closely tied to the firm's training capabilities and visible expansion strategy, and the growing partner network gives management further reason to continue backing it.

Emissions monitoring and compliance services sit near the core offer, support the firm's publicly stated environmental direction, and early deadline-meeting results strongly reinforce continued commitment.
The emissions compliance dashboard is integrated into the firm's PAL software and digitalisation agenda, so sunk development effort and strategic importance make withdrawal unlikely.

The emissions compliance cost simulation tool builds on the same software and compliance push, and management would be inclined to justify and continue this recent investment unless failure became unmistakable.
